name: Runner Extras - TestPage InsertAllowed
brief: Proves TestPage.New() inserts a row on an insertable page, and still throws on a page declaring InsertAllowed = false.
description: Reproduces the second layer of the Pageworks TestPage cluster (8 tests). The runner's ITestPage implementation hardcoded Creatable => false, so BC's New() ALWAYS threw NavInsertDeniedPermissionException ('New method failed because Insert is not allowed. Page = , Id = 0') regardless of the page's actual InsertAllowed property — a silent fake that makes every insert-through-TestPage test fail. RED (before the fix): New() on an ordinary page throws. GREEN (after the fix): Creatable reflects the page's parsed InsertAllowed (defaulting to true), so New() inserts, and a page that genuinely declares InsertAllowed = false still refuses.
